dict.string: Notchy requires permission to control system media playback.
Notchy requires Accessibility permissions to manage and click menu bar items.
Notchy requires Screen Recording permission to display window previews, capture recordings, and save instant replays.
Notchy listens to the music player's sound only to animate the equalizer bars. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Notchy requires Microphone access to record voice audio alongside screen recordings.
Notchy sends notifications when AI agents finish tasks and screen recordings are saved.
Notchy requires access to the Downloads folder to save screen recordings and instant replays.
Notchy requires access to the Desktop folder to save screen recordings and instant replays.
Notchy requires access to the Documents folder to save screen recordings and instant replays.
